name: Anne Bleeker
title: Corporate communications strategist and trainer
bio_short: Corporate communications strategist with more than 25 years' international experience. Former Director of Corporate Communications at Jumeirah Group. Co-founder of In2 Consulting, Dubai. Former MEPRA board member. MBA, University of Colorado.
bio: Anne is a corporate communications strategist and trainer with more than 25 years' international experience across multiple industries and highly multicultural environments. Her career has been primarily in-house, leading the development, planning and management of communication strategies, internal and external campaigns, crisis communications and stakeholder engagement programmes for major international organisations including Jumeirah Group, Future Pipe Industries and the Rezidor Hotel Group.  In 2010, she co-founded In2 Consulting, an award-winning boutique strategic communications agency based in Dubai specialising in hospitality and technology. The agency won the 2018 UAE Business Awards for Best Hospitality PR Agency and was shortlisted for the PRCA MENA Awards. Anne holds an MBA from the University of Colorado and a Bachelor's degree in hotel administration from the Hotel School The Hague. She is a former board member of the Middle East Public Relations Association (MEPRA).  At ISOC, Anne delivers corporate communications, crisis communication and stakeholder engagement programmes. She also teaches communications courses at Zayed University, Middlesex University and the Higher Colleges of Technology. Her in-house perspective is particularly valuable for clients who want training grounded in the realities of managing communications within complex organisations. Anne is based in Dubai and trains in English and Dutch.
bio_long: Anne is a corporate communications strategist and trainer with more than 25 years' international experience across multiple industries and highly multicultural environments. Originally from the Netherlands, she has lived in the UAE since 2001. Her career has been primarily in-house, leading the development, planning and management of communication strategies, internal and external campaigns, crisis communications and stakeholder engagement programmes for major international organisations including Jumeirah Group, where she was Director of Corporate Communications, Future Pipe Industries, where she was Vice President of Corporate Communications, and the Rezidor Hotel Group.  In 2010, she co-founded In2 Consulting, an award-winning boutique strategic communications agency based in Dubai specialising in hospitality and technology. The agency won the 2018 UAE Business Awards for Best Hospitality PR Agency and was shortlisted for the PRCA MENA Awards. Anne holds an MBA from the University of Colorado and a Bachelor's degree in hotel administration from the Hotel School The Hague. She is a former board member of the Middle East Public Relations Association (MEPRA), a member of PRCA MENA and the International Association of Business Communicators (IABC).  At ISOC, Anne delivers corporate communications, crisis communication and stakeholder engagement programmes. She also teaches communications courses at Zayed University, Middlesex University and the Higher Colleges of Technology. Her in-house perspective is particularly valuable for clients who want training grounded in the realities of managing communications within complex organisations rather than from an agency viewpoint. She brings practical experience of building communications functions, managing real crises and aligning communications with business strategy at board level. Anne is based in Dubai and trains in English and Dutch.
